title: What Does the Room Punish?
headline: Why Men Hide What They Struggle With
headline_sub: What the Room Punishes, People Learn to Hide
tagline: Sometimes we hide not because we don’t know the truth, but because we have learned what telling the truth will cost us.
seo_title: Why Men Hide Their Struggles (John 9:22) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: A room can teach hiding without ever saying hide. A devotional for men on John 9:22 and building a brotherhood where truth is safe to tell.
verse_text: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders….

scriptures.text: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders….
Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is kept safe.

items: Yesterday we asked, “What does the room reward?”
But every culture has another side.
If reward teaches, “Do this and you belong,”
punishment teaches, “Do that and you may not.”

blocks.text: And eventually people learn what not to say here.

items: A man born blind has been healed by Jesus.

blocks.text: “If nobody tells me to hide, nobody is teaching me to hide.”

items: A man shares something vulnerable. Someone jokes. Lesson learned.
A man admits his marriage is struggling. Everyone gets uncomfortable. Lesson learned.
A man confesses sin. His confession becomes gossip. Lesson learned.
A man cries. Someone calls him soft. Lesson learned.

blocks.text: What a community punishes determines what people learn to hide.

items: The man still has the temptation, the fear, the doubt, the loneliness.
But he has learned: don’t bring it here.
Biblical masculinity does not require emotional dishonesty.
A healthy room makes it safe to tell the truth and dangerous to keep lying to yourself.
